paragraphs.text: A

Whitehay Youth Music is intended for anyone aged between 6 and 14 who is keen to perform in public. The club is limited to 30 members at any time, and we operate a waiting list for membership.Two concerts are performed every year, and every member takes part. Members must have reached at least an intermediate standard on their instrument.The group meets in the Jubilee Hall on Wednesday evenings during term time for rehearsals and for workshops in which members learn how to improve their playing.
paragraphs.translation:
Whitehay Youth Music 面向所有年龄在6至14岁之间、热衷于公开表演的人。
该俱乐部的人数在任何时候都限制在30人以内，我们设有会员候补名单。
每年举办两场音乐会，所有成员都要参加。
成员的乐器演奏水平必须至少达到中级标准。
在学期期间，该团体每周三晚上在 Jubilee Hall 集会，进行排练和工作坊，成员们在其中学习如何提升演奏技巧。
Whitehay 青少年音乐社团面向所有年龄在6至14岁之间、热衷于在公众面前表演的人。
该社团在任何时候都限制为30名成员，并且我们设有候补名单以供入会。
每年举办两场音乐会，每位成员都参与表演。
成员必须至少在乐器演奏上达到中级水平。
该团体在学期内的周三晚上于Jubilee大厅集合，进行排练和研讨会，成员们借此学习如何提升演奏技巧。

paragraphs.text: B

Whitehay Music Club brings together music lovers from around the district, for enjoyable evenings of food and music. We meet monthly in members' homes,and during the evening we have a buffet meal and listen to recordings of both well-known and not so well-known music.The music is preceded by a brief talk providing background information about the composers and the music. Every few months we organise a coach trip to a musical event within a radius of 50 km.
paragraphs.translation:
Whitehay音乐俱乐部汇集了来自该地区的音乐爱好者，共度美食与音乐的美妙夜晚。
我们每月在成员家中聚会，晚上会享用自助餐，并聆听知名与不太知名音乐的录音。
在播放音乐之前，会有一场简短讲座，提供作曲家和音乐的相关背景信息。
每隔几个月，我们就会组织一次大巴旅行，前往方圆50公里内的音乐活动。

paragraphs.text: C

Whitehay Philharmonic is an amateur orchestra, founded in 1954. Two or three times a year, it performs a wide range of music to large and appreciative audiences from the area, in the town's Jubilee Hall. New members are always welcome,and can take part in rehearsals,although there may not be room for everyone to perform in the concerts.Because the orchestra only partly finances its performances through ticket sales, members with marketing experience are particularly welcome, in order to build sales.
paragraphs.translation:
Whitehay Philharmonic 是一个业余管弦乐团，成立于1954年。
每年两到三次，它会在镇上的 Jubilee Hall 为当地众多且欣赏的观众演奏各种音乐。
新成员始终受到欢迎，可以参加排练，尽管可能没有足够空间让每个人都在音乐会上表演。
由于管弦乐团仅部分通过售票来资助演出，因此特别欢迎具有营销经验的成员，以提高售票量。
Whitehay爱乐乐团是一个业余管弦乐团，成立于1954年。
每年有两到三次，它在该镇的Jubilee大厅为来自该地区的众多且充满欣赏力的观众演奏各种音乐。
新成员总是受欢迎的，可以参加排练，尽管可能没有空间让每个人都在音乐会上表演。
由于管弦乐团仅部分通过门票销售来为其演出提供资金，因此特别欢迎有市场营销经验的成员，以促进销售。

paragraphs.text: D

Whitehay Music Society is primarily a fundraising group that organises a range of money-making activities - from street collections to seeking sponsorship from local businesses.The money raised is used to support professional musicians if, for example, illness prevents them from earning a living.As a member, you will receive a monthly newsletter describing our work,and containing details of concerts, operas and other performances, both locally and nationally. Everybody is welcome to join the society: children are particularly welcome, along with their parents.
paragraphs.translation:
Whitehay音乐协会主要是一个筹款团体，组织一系列赚钱活动——从街头募捐到寻求当地企业的赞助。
筹集的资金用于支持专业音乐家，例如，当疾病使他们无法谋生时。
作为会员，您将每月收到一份通讯，描述我们的工作，并包含当地和全国范围内音乐会、歌剧及其他演出的详细信息。
欢迎所有人加入该协会：儿童尤其受到欢迎，连同他们的父母一起。
筹集的资金用于支持专业音乐家，例如当他们因疾病无法谋生时。
作为会员，您将收到一份每月简报，描述我们的工作，并包含本地及全国范围内音乐会、歌剧及其他演出的详细信息。
欢迎所有人加入协会：特别欢迎儿童及其家长一同加入。

paragraphs.text: Biological Research Institute
paragraphs.translation: 生物研究所

paragraphs.text: Welcome to the Biological Research Institute campus. We hope that your visit will be enjoyable and interesting. Please read the information below and comply with the instructions given.
paragraphs.translation:
生物研究所
欢迎来到生物研究所园区。
我们希望您的参观既愉快又有趣。
请阅读以下信息并遵守所给指示。

paragraphs.text: On arrival, you should report to the Reception building by the main entrance gate,where you will be issued with a pass. This must be visible at all times during your visit to the campus.
paragraphs.translation:
抵达时，您应前往主入口旁的接待处报到，在那里您将领取一张通行证。
在您参观校园期间，此通行证必须始终佩戴在显眼处。

paragraphs.text: If you are driving a vehicle, please inform Reception. They will contact Security, who will identify the area where you should park your car. Please ensure that you park it in the designated area. You must keep to the campus speed limit (10 mph) at all times.Cars are parked at the owner's risk.
paragraphs.translation:
如果您驾驶车辆，请告知接待处。他们将联系安保部门，由安保人员指定您应停车的位置。
请确保将车辆停放在指定区域。
您必须始终遵守园区限速规定（10英里/小时）。
车辆停放风险由车主自行承担。

paragraphs.text: For your own safety, please follow the instructions displayed on noticeboards around the campus, as well as all instructions issued by authorised personnel. Do not enter any restricted areas or touch any machinery or other equipment unless authorised. Visitors must be accompanied by their host at all times whilst on the campus.
paragraphs.translation:
为了你自身的安全，请遵守校园公告栏上显示的指示，以及授权人员发布的所有指令。
未经授权，不得进入任何限制区域，或触碰任何机器及其他设备。
访客在校园内必须始终由接待人员陪同。

paragraphs.text: Entry into certain areas requires the wearing of special clothing or equipment.This will be provided for you by your host, who will advise you on the appropriate protection for the areas you visit.
paragraphs.translation:
进入某些区域需要穿戴特殊的服装或装备。
您的接待人会为您提供这些物品，并告知您访问区域所需的适当防护措施。

paragraphs.text: Unless your host has previously obtained permission from the Institute management, photography, whether still or video, is not permitted in any part of the campus.
paragraphs.translation: 除非您的陪同人员事先已获得研究所管理部门的许可，否则园区内任何区域均不允许进行摄影，无论是静态拍摄还是视频录制。

paragraphs.text: Children under the age of 16 must be accompanied by an adult at all times, and should only be brought on campus if the Institute management has previously agreed to this. No nursery facilities are available for visiting children.
paragraphs.translation:
16岁以下儿童必须始终由成人陪同，且只有当研究所管理部门事先同意后，才能将其带入校园。
参观儿童没有托儿设施可用。

paragraphs.text: In the event of an accident, call 3333 and request the assistance of site first-aid personnel.
paragraphs.translation: 如果发生事故，请拨打3333并请求现场急救人员的协助。

parts.title: Passage 2
parts.article_title: Negotiating a better salary package for your new job

paragraphs.text: If you make it through the recruitment interview, a job offer may be just around the corner and you face having to talk about the nitty-gritty: your financial value.
paragraphs.translation: 如果你成功通过了招聘面试，工作机会可能就在眼前，而你将面临必须讨论关键细节的问题：你的经济价值。

paragraphs.text: Although many graduate training schemes have set starting salaries, there are loads of other jobs where you'll need to exercise your negotiating skills. If you're offered a job, it's because the organisation sees you as a valuable asset and you should try to set your level of remuneration accordingly.
paragraphs.translation:
尽管许多毕业生培训计划设定了固定的起薪，但在大量其他工作中，你需要运用你的谈判技巧。
如果你被录用，那是因为该组织视你为有价值的资产，而你应该据此努力确定自己的薪酬水平。

paragraphs.text: There are no general rules about how and when to conduct your negotiation but being sensitive to the culture of the organisation is essential. There are also some practical steps you can take to position yourself sensibly. Familiarise yourself with the company itself, as well as the range of salaries on offer. Doing careful research in this way prior to starting negotiations is very valuable. You can look at the range of packages offered for comparable jobs in adverts on the internet, or ask for advice from people you know professionally or personally. You could also approach a local Training and Enterprise Council. Finally, if you're a member of a union, they will have information on acceptable salary ranges for your profession.
paragraphs.translation:
关于如何进行以及何时进行谈判，并没有普遍的规则，但对组织文化保持敏感是至关重要的。
此外，你还可以采取一些实际步骤来明智地定位自己。
熟悉公司本身以及所提供的薪资范围。
在开始谈判之前以这种方式进行仔细研究是非常有价值的。
你可以查看互联网广告中为类似职位提供的薪酬范围，或者向你的职业或个人圈子里的人征求意见。
你也可以联系当地的培训和企业委员会。
最后，如果你是一个工会的成员，他们会有关于你职业可接受薪资范围的信息。

paragraphs.text: If the salary offered is less than you'd hoped for,you could negotiate an early pay review instead, say after the first six months. Ensure that the criteria are clearly set out though, and that they're included in your contract.
paragraphs.translation:
如果提供的薪水低于你的期望，你可以协商尽早进行薪酬评估，比如在头六个月之后。
不过，要确保评估标准明确列出，并且包含在你的合同中。

paragraphs.text: Make sure you check out the salary package, not just the number of zeroes on your payslip. You may find that the total package of pay and benefits raises the worth of the salary to an acceptable level.For instance, you may be offered private health cover, a non-contributory pension, a car to use for work purposes and/or significant bonuses. When bonuses are mentioned, you may want to discuss the basis on which they're paid, so that you're absolutely clear about the terms and conditions attached.when negotiating, be persuasive and consistent in your arguments but be prepared to agree to a compromise if you really want the job.
paragraphs.translation:
确保你仔细查看整体薪资待遇，而不仅仅是工资单上的数字零位。
你可能会发现，薪资和福利的整体组合能将薪水价值提升至可接受的水平。
例如，你可能会获得私人医疗保险、无需个人缴费的养老金、用于工作的车辆和/或可观的奖金。
当提及奖金时，你可能希望讨论其支付基础，以便完全清楚附带条款和条件。
在谈判时，你的论点要有说服力且保持一致，但如果你真的想要这份工作，也要准备同意妥协。

paragraphs.text: If your negotiations are successful, ask for the agreed terms and conditions to be confirmed in writing ASAP.
paragraphs.translation: 如果你的谈判成功，请要求尽快以书面形式确认商定的条款和条件。

paragraphs.text: How to run a successful project
paragraphs.translation: 如何成功运作一个项目

paragraphs.text: A project manager's main task is to bring a particular project to completion, both on time and within budget.There are many factors that can cause a project to veer off its tracks, but steps can be taken to ensure that your project experiences as little disruption as possible.
paragraphs.translation:
项目经理的主要任务是按时且在预算范围内完成特定项目。
有许多因素可能导致项目偏离轨道，但可以采取措施来确保你的项目经历尽可能少的干扰。

paragraphs.text: 1.Prepare the framework
paragraphs.translation: 1. 准备框架

paragraphs.text: If you get everything down in writing at the beginning of the project, you have an excellent foundation to build upon. Change is inevitable, but you have to maintain control. This is critical to avoid problems of 'scope creep', which is when the company paying for the project asks for "just one more little thing' repeatedly,until the project becomes unmanageable.
paragraphs.translation:
如果你在项目开始时将所有内容以书面形式确定下来，你就有了一个可以依赖的绝佳基础。
变化是不可避免的，但你必须保持控制。
这对于避免‘范围蔓延’的问题至关重要，即支付项目费用的公司反复要求‘再多加一点小东西’，直到项目变得难以管理。

paragraphs.text: 2.Select the team
paragraphs.translation: 2. 选择团队

paragraphs.text: Gather your human resources,and make sure that their skills align with their roles.This is an important first step: if you assign the wrong person to a task, you are reducing your chances of success.
paragraphs.translation:
召集你的团队成员，并确保他们的技能与其角色相匹配。
这是重要的第一步：如果你将错误的人选指派给某项任务，你就在降低成功的几率。

paragraphs.text: Make sure each team member is clear on what is expected from them and when. Encourage them to ask questions to clarify anything that may be uncertain, and to always come to you whenever something seems to be out of place or going wrong. Clear communication is critical.
paragraphs.translation:
确保每位团队成员都清楚对他们的期望是什么，以及何时完成。
鼓励他们提出疑问以澄清任何可能不确定的事项，并始终在遇到任何不对劲或出错的情况时来找你。
清晰的沟通至关重要。

paragraphs.text: Make sure the whole team and the client company grasp the project's limitations in terms of its achievable outcomes.You can finish a task successfully and on time as long as expectations are reasonable.
paragraphs.translation:
确保整个团队和客户公司都理解该项目在可实现成果方面的局限性。
只要期望合理，你就能按时成功地完成一项任务。

paragraphs.text: 3.Staying on track
paragraphs.translation: 3. 保持正轨

paragraphs.text: How can you know if your project is going to be successful if you don't have any way of measuring success? You will need interim milestones, especially for a long-term project, so that you can determine if you are staying on track or straying from the project's goals.
paragraphs.translation:
如果你没有任何衡量成功的方法，你怎么知道你的项目是否会成功？
你需要设立中期里程碑，尤其是对于长期项目而言，这样你才能判断自己是否按计划进行，还是偏离了项目的目标。

paragraphs.text: 4. Manage project risks
paragraphs.translation: 管理项目风险

paragraphs.text: Hopefully you have defined the more likely risks up front during the project preparation, so you should now put contingency plans in place for certain occurrences. If you can see when a risk is imminent, you can take preventive action to avoid it, but be ready to halt a project if the risk becomes unacceptable.
paragraphs.translation:
幸运的是，你在项目准备阶段已经提前明确了更可能出现的风险，因此现在应该针对某些情况制定应急计划。
如果你能预见到风险即将来临，你可以采取预防措施来避免它，但如果风险变得不可接受，也要准备好暂停项目。

paragraphs.text: 5.Evaluate the project
paragraphs.translation: 5. 评估项目

paragraphs.text: Once a project has been completed, it's important to write a report, even if it is only for internal purposes. You can pinpoint what went right or wrong, determine what could have been done differently, and establish the best practices for use in future undertakings.
paragraphs.translation:
一旦项目完成，撰写报告非常重要，即使仅用于内部目的。
你可以明确哪些地方做得好或出了问题，确定本可以采取哪些不同的做法，并建立最佳实践以供未来项目使用。

parts.source_article_title: Negotiating a better salary package for your new job

sentence_translations.sentence: If you make it through the recruitment interview, a job offer may be just around the corner and you face having to talk about the nitty-gritty: your financial value.
sentence_translations.translation: 如果你成功通过了招聘面试，工作机会可能就在眼前，而你将面临必须讨论关键细节的问题：你的经济价值。

sentence_translations.sentence: Although many graduate training schemes have set starting salaries, there are loads of other jobs where you'll need to exercise your negotiating skills.
sentence_translations.translation: 尽管许多毕业生培训计划设定了固定的起薪，但在大量其他工作中，你需要运用你的谈判技巧。

sentence_translations.sentence: If you're offered a job, it's because the organisation sees you as a valuable asset and you should try to set your level of remuneration accordingly.
sentence_translations.translation: 如果你被录用，那是因为该组织视你为有价值的资产，而你应该据此努力确定自己的薪酬水平。

sentence_translations.sentence: There are no general rules about how and when to conduct your negotiation but being sensitive to the culture of the organisation is essential.
sentence_translations.translation: 关于如何进行以及何时进行谈判，并没有普遍的规则，但对组织文化保持敏感是至关重要的。

sentence_translations.sentence: There are also some practical steps you can take to position yourself sensibly.
sentence_translations.translation: 此外，你还可以采取一些实际步骤来明智地定位自己。

sentence_translations.sentence: Familiarise yourself with the company itself, as well as the range of salaries on offer.
sentence_translations.translation: 熟悉公司本身以及所提供的薪资范围。

sentence_translations.sentence: Doing careful research in this way prior to starting negotiations is very valuable.
sentence_translations.translation: 在开始谈判之前以这种方式进行仔细研究是非常有价值的。

sentence_translations.sentence: You can look at the range of packages offered for comparable jobs in adverts on the internet, or ask for advice from people you know professionally or personally.
sentence_translations.translation: 你可以查看互联网广告中为类似职位提供的薪酬范围，或者向你的职业或个人圈子里的人征求意见。

sentence_translations.sentence: You could also approach a local Training and Enterprise Council.
sentence_translations.translation: 你也可以联系当地的培训和企业委员会。

sentence_translations.sentence: Finally, if you're a member of a union, they will have information on acceptable salary ranges for your profession.
sentence_translations.translation: 最后，如果你是一个工会的成员，他们会有关于你职业可接受薪资范围的信息。

sentence_translations.sentence: If the salary offered is less than you'd hoped for, you could negotiate an early pay review instead, say after the first six months.
sentence_translations.translation: 如果提供的薪水低于你的期望，你可以协商尽早进行薪酬评估，比如在头六个月之后。

sentence_translations.sentence: Ensure that the criteria are clearly set out though, and that they're included in your contract.
sentence_translations.translation: 不过，要确保评估标准明确列出，并且包含在你的合同中。

sentence_translations.sentence: Make sure you check out the salary package, not just the number of zeroes on your payslip.
sentence_translations.translation: 确保你仔细查看整体薪资待遇，而不仅仅是工资单上的数字零位。

sentence_translations.sentence: You may find that the total package of pay and benefits raises the worth of the salary to an acceptable level.
sentence_translations.translation: 你可能会发现，薪资和福利的整体组合能将薪水价值提升至可接受的水平。

sentence_translations.sentence: For instance, you may be offered private health cover, a non-contributory pension, a car to use for work purposes and/or significant bonuses.
sentence_translations.translation: 例如，你可能会获得私人医疗保险、无需个人缴费的养老金、用于工作的车辆和/或可观的奖金。

sentence_translations.sentence: When bonuses are mentioned, you may want to discuss the basis on which they're paid, so that you're absolutely clear about the terms and conditions attached.
sentence_translations.translation: 当提及奖金时，你可能希望讨论其支付基础，以便完全清楚附带条款和条件。

sentence_translations.sentence: when negotiating, be persuasive and consistent in your arguments but be prepared to agree to a compromise if you really want the job.
sentence_translations.translation: 在谈判时，你的论点要有说服力且保持一致，但如果你真的想要这份工作，也要准备同意妥协。

sentence_translations.sentence: If your negotiations are successful, ask for the agreed terms and conditions to be confirmed in writing ASAP.
sentence_translations.translation: 如果你的谈判成功，请要求尽快以书面形式确认商定的条款和条件。

sentence_translations.sentence: How to run a successful project
sentence_translations.translation: 如何成功运作一个项目

sentence_translations.sentence: A project manager's main task is to bring a particular project to completion, both on time and within budget.
sentence_translations.translation: 项目经理的主要任务是按时且在预算范围内完成特定项目。

sentence_translations.sentence: There are many factors that can cause a project to veer off its tracks, but steps can be taken to ensure that your project experiences as little disruption as possible.
sentence_translations.translation: 有许多因素可能导致项目偏离轨道，但可以采取措施来确保你的项目经历尽可能少的干扰。

sentence_translations.sentence: 1.Prepare the framework
sentence_translations.translation: 1. 准备框架

sentence_translations.sentence: If you get everything down in writing at the beginning of the project, you have an excellent foundation to build upon.
sentence_translations.translation: 如果你在项目开始时将所有内容以书面形式确定下来，你就有了一个可以依赖的绝佳基础。

sentence_translations.sentence: Change is inevitable, but you have to maintain control.
sentence_translations.translation: 变化是不可避免的，但你必须保持控制。

sentence_translations.sentence: This is critical to avoid problems of 'scope creep', which is when the company paying for the project asks for 'just one more little thing' repeatedly, until the project becomes unmanageable.
sentence_translations.translation: 这对于避免‘范围蔓延’的问题至关重要，即支付项目费用的公司反复要求‘再多加一点小东西’，直到项目变得难以管理。

sentence_translations.sentence: 2.Select the team
sentence_translations.translation: 2. 选择团队

sentence_translations.sentence: Gather your human resources, and make sure that their skills align with their roles.
sentence_translations.translation: 召集你的团队成员，并确保他们的技能与其角色相匹配。

sentence_translations.sentence: This is an important first step: if you assign the wrong person to a task, you are reducing your chances of success.
sentence_translations.translation: 这是重要的第一步：如果你将错误的人选指派给某项任务，你就在降低成功的几率。

sentence_translations.sentence: Make sure each team member is clear on what is expected from them and when.
sentence_translations.translation: 确保每位团队成员都清楚对他们的期望是什么，以及何时完成。

sentence_translations.sentence: Encourage them to ask questions to clarify anything that may be uncertain, and to always come to you whenever something seems to be out of place or going wrong.
sentence_translations.translation: 鼓励他们提出疑问以澄清任何可能不确定的事项，并始终在遇到任何不对劲或出错的情况时来找你。

sentence_translations.sentence: Clear communication is critical.
sentence_translations.translation: 清晰的沟通至关重要。

sentence_translations.sentence: Make sure the whole team and the client company grasp the project's limitations in terms of its achievable outcomes.
sentence_translations.translation: 确保整个团队和客户公司都理解该项目在可实现成果方面的局限性。

sentence_translations.sentence: You can finish a task successfully and on time as long as expectations are reasonable.
sentence_translations.translation: 只要期望合理，你就能按时成功地完成一项任务。

sentence_translations.sentence: 3.Staying on track
sentence_translations.translation: 3. 保持正轨

sentence_translations.sentence: How can you know if your project is going to be successful if you don't have any way of measuring success?
sentence_translations.translation: 如果你没有任何衡量成功的方法，你怎么知道你的项目是否会成功？

sentence_translations.sentence: You will need interim milestones, especially for a long-term project, so that you can determine if you are staying on track or straying from the project's goals.
sentence_translations.translation: 你需要设立中期里程碑，尤其是对于长期项目而言，这样你才能判断自己是否按计划进行，还是偏离了项目的目标。

sentence_translations.sentence: Manage project risks
sentence_translations.translation: 管理项目风险

sentence_translations.sentence: Hopefully you have defined the more likely risks up front during the project preparation, so you should now put contingency plans in place for certain occurrences.
sentence_translations.translation: 幸运的是，你在项目准备阶段已经提前明确了更可能出现的风险，因此现在应该针对某些情况制定应急计划。

sentence_translations.sentence: If you can see when a risk is imminent, you can take preventive action to avoid it, but be ready to halt a project if the risk becomes unacceptable.
sentence_translations.translation: 如果你能预见到风险即将来临，你可以采取预防措施来避免它，但如果风险变得不可接受，也要准备好暂停项目。

sentence_translations.sentence: 5.Evaluate the project
sentence_translations.translation: 5. 评估项目

sentence_translations.sentence: Once a project has been completed, it's important to write a report, even if it is only for internal purposes.
sentence_translations.translation: 一旦项目完成，撰写报告非常重要，即使仅用于内部目的。

sentence_translations.sentence: You can pinpoint what went right or wrong, determine what could have been done differently, and establish the best practices for use in future undertakings.
sentence_translations.translation: 你可以明确哪些地方做得好或出了问题，确定本可以采取哪些不同的做法，并建立最佳实践以供未来项目使用。

parts.article_title: Mass appeal of the manta rays

paragraphs.text: A

I am underwater, face to face with a large flat fish which I recognise immediately as being a manta ray.For an instant I look straight into its gaping mouth and see the row of small, flattened teeth in its lower jaw.Close on its tail comes another manta ray, and another and another. The manta rays are unaffected by my being there, cruising past in a leisurely fashion without seeming to expend any great effort.
paragraphs.translation:
我在水下，与一条巨大的扁平鱼类面对面，我立刻认出这是一只蝠鲼。
一瞬间，我直视它张开的嘴巴，看到它下颚的一排细小、扁平的牙齿。
紧跟在它尾巴后面的是另一只蝠鲼，接着又是一只，又一只。
蝠鲼们丝毫不受我在此处存在的影响，悠闲地游过，似乎毫不费力。
我在水下，与一条我立刻认出是蝠鲼的大型扁平鱼类面对面。
一瞬间，我直视它张开的嘴巴，看到了它下颚上一排细小而扁平的牙齿。
紧跟着它的尾巴，又来了另一条蝠鲼，接着一条又一条。
这些蝠鲼并未因我的存在而受到影响，它们悠闲地游过，似乎毫不费力。

paragraphs.text: B

From above, the manta rays are great black silhouettes that fishermen called 'devil fish', because of the curious horn-like fins hanging down near their mouths. But looking into their eyes you get a sense of their peaceful nature. Unlike stingrays,mantas don't have venomous spines in their tails,and unlike many fish species they seem to enjoy human company.Once, over-enthusiastically, I swim towards a manta.I am just a few inches away when it senses me. To my surprise, the whole fish twitches in alarm and shoots off, perhaps fearing that I will touch it. I feel ashamed to have given it a fright.
paragraphs.translation:
从上方俯瞰，蝠鲼呈现巨大的黑色轮廓，由于它们嘴巴附近垂有奇特的角状鳍，渔民们称其为“魔鬼鱼”。
然而，凝视它们的眼睛，你会感受到它们温顺的天性。
与刺鳐不同，蝠鲼的尾巴上没有毒刺，而且与许多鱼类不同，它们似乎享受人类的陪伴。
有一次，我过于兴奋地游向一只蝠鲼。
就在我距它不过几英寸时，它感知到了我。
令我惊讶的是，这条鱼惊恐地全身一颤，迅速游走，或许是害怕我会触碰到它。
我为自己吓到它而感到羞愧。
从上方看，蝠鲼是巨大的黑色轮廓，渔民称之为"魔鬼鱼"，因为它们的嘴巴附近垂着奇怪的角状鳍。
但是，看着它们的眼睛，你会感受到它们温和的天性。
与刺鳐不同，蝠鲼的尾巴上没有毒刺，而且与许多鱼类不同，它们似乎喜欢与人类为伴。
有一次，我过于热情地游向一只蝠鲼。
我距离它仅几英寸时，它察觉到了我。
令我惊讶的是，整条鱼惊慌地抽动并迅速游走，也许它害怕我会碰到它。
我为自己吓到了它而感到羞愧。

paragraphs.text: C

I have come to Hanifaru, a small lagoon next to an uninhabited island in the Maldives, especially to see manta rays. These great harmless creatures congregate here during the south-west monsoons between May and November and, if the tides and winds are right, enter a shallow cul-de-sac in the reef to hunt for plankton, their main source of nutrition.On certain days the bay can attract more than 100 mantas. I have seen many manta rays on dives around the world,though not in these numbers.
paragraphs.translation:
我来到哈尼法鲁——马尔代夫一个无人岛旁的小环礁湖——专门为了观赏蝠鲼。
这些巨大而无害的生物在5月至11月的西南季风期间聚集于此，若潮汐和风向适宜，它们还会进入礁石中一个浅水死胡同，捕食其主要的营养来源——浮游生物。
在某些日子里，这片海湾能吸引超过100只蝠鲼。
我在世界各地的潜水中见过许多蝠鲼，但数量从未如此之多。

paragraphs.text: D

Guy Stevens is my guide, a British marine biologist who has been studying the mantas for the past five years. Based at the nearby Four Seasons resort, he has identified more than 2,000 individual manta rays, photographing and cataloguing them according to their distinctive skin patterns. Each day we make the 40-minute boat journey from the resort to Hanifaru. Feeding events,as Guy calls them, are never guaranteed, but, during the season, hotel guests can sign up for 'manta alerts'. If Guy and his research assistants spot significant manta activity, the guests will be brought by fast speedboat to the lagoon to snorkel. When feeding, the mantas of Hanifaru tend to stay near the surface, making them accessible to snorkellers just as much as divers. They seem not to mind the human competition in this quite small space,and indeed they are often joined by other rays and even giant whale sharks, which feed on the same plankton.
paragraphs.translation:
盖伊·史蒂文斯是我的向导，一位过去五年一直在研究蝠鲼的英国海洋生物学家。
他在附近的四季酒店工作，已识别出超过2000条蝠鲼，根据它们独特的皮肤花纹拍摄并编目。
每天我们从度假村乘船40分钟前往哈尼法鲁。
盖伊所称的摄食活动并非总能保证发生，但在季节期间，酒店客人可以报名参加‘蝠鲼警报’。
如果盖伊和他的研究助理发现显著的蝠鲼活动，客人将乘坐快艇被带到潟湖进行浮潜。
摄食时，哈尼法鲁的蝠鲼往往停留在水面附近，这使得浮潜者和潜水者同样容易接近它们。
它们似乎不介意在这个相当狭小的空间里与人类竞争，而且实际上，它们经常与其他鳐鱼甚至以相同浮游生物为食的巨大鲸鲨相伴。

paragraphs.text: E

Word among the diving community about the possibility of finding a mass of manta rays at Hanifaru has slowly been spreading over the past year. Outside the shallow lagoon I can see five large safari boats - live-aboard cruisers that take divers around the best underwater sites in the Maldives. It is something that Guy has been monitoring closely. "Word is out that Hanifaru is a top manta spot, ' he explains, 'and although the government has declared the bay a "protected area", we still don't have any regulations in force to limit the number of people in the water at any onetime.'
paragraphs.translation:
在过去一年里，关于在哈尼法鲁可能发现大量蝠鲼的消息在潜水界中慢慢传开。
在浅水泻湖外，我可以看到五艘大型观光船——这些是提供住宿的游船，能带领潜水者前往马尔代夫最佳的水下地点。
盖伊一直在密切关注这一情况。
他解释道：“消息传出，哈尼法鲁是一个顶级蝠鲼观赏点，尽管政府已宣布该海湾为‘保护区’，但我们仍没有有效的法规来限制任何时候在水中的游客数量。”

这是盖伊一直在密切关注的事情。
“消息传出，哈尼法鲁是一流的蝠鲼地点，”他解释道，“尽管政府已将该海湾宣布为‘保护区’，但我们仍然没有生效的规定来限制任何时候在水中的人数。”

paragraphs.text: F

During my stay, the resort received a visit from the then-president of the Maldives, Mohamed Nasheed. Since coming to power in 2008, he had made his interest in the marine environment and concerns about climate change well known. In 2009 he held an underwater cabinet meeting, urging other world leaders to act decisively to combat climate change.The protection of wildlife areas such as Hanifaru was clearly one of his objectives, and I asked him why he took such an interest. ’Maldivians have lived with the reefs and their fish life since long before there were tourists,’ he said.’And while tourist dollars are good for our country, the sea and its produce are even more vital to my people. I have to balance what tourists want to see with preserving the marine environment - and in some cases, like Hanifaru, those objectives coincide.’
paragraphs.translation:
在我停留期间，度假村接待了时任马尔代夫总统穆罕默德·纳希德的来访。
自2008年执政以来，他明确表达了对海洋环境的兴趣以及对气候变化的担忧。
2009年，他举行了一次水下内阁会议，敦促其他世界领导人果断采取行动应对气候变化。
保护像哈尼法鲁这样的野生动物区域显然是他目标之一，我问他为何对此如此关注。
他说：“早在游客出现之前，马尔代夫人就与珊瑚礁及其鱼类生活共存。”
“虽然旅游收入对我们国家有利，但海洋及其产物对我的人民更为重要。
我必须平衡游客想看的内容与保护海洋环境之间的关系——在某些情况下，比如哈尼法鲁，这些目标是一致的。”

paragraphs.text: G

On several dives I am lucky enough to get close to the mantas,sometimes at underwater 'cleaning stations'. Here, the mantas come in small numbers, or individually, to pause above a coral outcrop and wait while small fish pick at their skin, removing parasites.Adapted for fast swimming with their flattened bodies,they can accelerate rapidly with a twitch of their wings.They gaze at human swimmers with a kind of knowing calm, something people often remark on when they try to capture the emotion they experience after seeing them. 'The manta rays have the biggest brain of any fish,' Guy explains, 'and some manta researchers are convinced that mantas can recognise individual people underwater.'
paragraphs.translation:
在几次潜水中，我有幸靠近蝠鲼，有时是在水下的“清洁站”。
在这里，蝠鲼三五成群或单独行动，停在珊瑚礁露头上方等待，让小鱼啄食它们的皮肤，清除寄生虫。
凭借扁平的身体适应快速游动，它们只需扇动一下翅膀就能迅速加速。
它们以一种似有深意的平静凝视着人类游泳者，人们在试图描述见到它们后的感受时常常提及这一点。
“蝠鲼拥有所有鱼类中最大的大脑，”盖伊解释道，“一些蝠鲼研究者确信，蝠鲼能在水下辨认出不同的人。”

paragraphs.text: H

I return to the lagoon over the course of several days and learn more from Guy about his hopes for the future. ‘People can visit this place, but I want to be sure that they don't harass the mantas by touching them or crowding them out while they're feeding. We're working to get a full-time ranger station and some kind of permit system to limit the number of boats that can enter the lagoon each day.’

我连续几天返回泻湖，并从盖伊那里进一步了解了他对未来的期望。
“人们可以参观这个地方，但我希望确保他们不会在蝠鲼进食时通过触摸或拥挤它们来骚扰它们。

sentence_translations.translation: 令我惊讶的是，整条鱼惊慌地抽动并迅速游走，也许它害怕我会碰到它。

sentence_translations.sentence: I feel ashamed to have given it a fright.
sentence_translations.translation: 我为自己吓到了它而感到羞愧。

sentence_translations.sentence: I have come to Hanifaru, a small lagoon next to an uninhabited island in the Maldives, especially to see manta rays.
sentence_translations.translation: 我来到哈尼法鲁——马尔代夫一个无人岛旁的小环礁湖——专门为了观赏蝠鲼。

sentence_translations.sentence: These great harmless creatures congregate here during the south-west monsoons between May and November and, if the tides and winds are right, enter a shallow cul-de-sac in the reef to hunt for plankton, their main source of nutrition.
sentence_translations.translation: 这些巨大而无害的生物在5月至11月的西南季风期间聚集于此，若潮汐和风向适宜，它们还会进入礁石中一个浅水死胡同，捕食其主要的营养来源——浮游生物。

sentence_translations.sentence: On certain days the bay can attract more than 100 mantas.
sentence_translations.translation: 在某些日子里，这片海湾能吸引超过100只蝠鲼。

sentence_translations.sentence: I have seen many manta rays on dives around the world, though not in these numbers.
sentence_translations.translation: 我在世界各地的潜水中见过许多蝠鲼，但数量从未如此之多。

sentence_translations.sentence: Guy Stevens is my guide, a British marine biologist who has been studying the mantas for the past five years.
sentence_translations.translation: 盖伊·史蒂文斯是我的向导，一位过去五年一直在研究蝠鲼的英国海洋生物学家。

sentence_translations.sentence: Based at the nearby Four Seasons resort, he has identified more than 2,000 individual manta rays, photographing and cataloguing them according to their distinctive skin patterns.
sentence_translations.translation: 他在附近的四季酒店工作，已识别出超过2000条蝠鲼，根据它们独特的皮肤花纹拍摄并编目。

sentence_translations.sentence: Each day we make the 40-minute boat journey from the resort to Hanifaru.
sentence_translations.translation: 每天我们从度假村乘船40分钟前往哈尼法鲁。

sentence_translations.sentence: Feeding events,as Guy calls them, are never guaranteed, but, during the season, hotel guests can sign up for 'manta alerts'.
sentence_translations.translation: 盖伊所称的摄食活动并非总能保证发生，但在季节期间，酒店客人可以报名参加‘蝠鲼警报’。

sentence_translations.sentence: If Guy and his research assistants spot significant manta activity, the guests will be brought by fast speedboat to the lagoon to snorkel.
sentence_translations.translation: 如果盖伊和他的研究助理发现显著的蝠鲼活动，客人将乘坐快艇被带到潟湖进行浮潜。

sentence_translations.sentence: When feeding, the mantas of Hanifaru tend to stay near the surface, making them accessible to snorkellers just as much as divers.
sentence_translations.translation: 摄食时，哈尼法鲁的蝠鲼往往停留在水面附近，这使得浮潜者和潜水者同样容易接近它们。

sentence_translations.sentence: They seem not to mind the human competition in this quite small space,and indeed they are often joined by other rays and even giant whale sharks, which feed on the same plankton.
sentence_translations.translation: 它们似乎不介意在这个相当狭小的空间里与人类竞争，而且实际上，它们经常与其他鳐鱼甚至以相同浮游生物为食的巨大鲸鲨相伴。

sentence_translations.sentence: Guy Stevens is my guide, a British marine biologist who has been studying the mantas for the past five years.
sentence_translations.translation: 盖伊·史蒂文斯是我的向导，他是一位英国海洋生物学家，过去五年一直在研究蝠鲼。

sentence_translations.sentence: Based at the nearby Four Seasons resort, he has identified more than 2,000 individual manta rays, photographing and cataloguing them according to their distinctive skin patterns.
sentence_translations.translation: 他在附近的四季酒店工作，已辨认出超过2000条蝠鲼，并根据它们独特的皮肤纹理进行拍照和分类。

sentence_translations.sentence: Each day we make the 40-minute boat journey from the resort to Hanifaru.
sentence_translations.translation: 每天我们都要从度假村乘船40分钟前往哈尼法鲁。

sentence_translations.sentence: Feeding events,as Guy calls them, are never guaranteed, but, during the season, hotel guests can sign up for 'manta alerts'.
sentence_translations.translation: 盖伊所称的“进食活动”从未有保证，但在季节期间，酒店客人可以注册“蝠鲼警报”。

sentence_translations.sentence: If Guy and his research assistants spot significant manta activity, the guests will be brought by fast speedboat to the lagoon to snorkel.
sentence_translations.translation: 如果盖伊和他的研究助理发现显著的蝠鲼活动，客人将乘坐快艇前往泻湖浮潜。

sentence_translations.sentence: When feeding, the mantas of Hanifaru tend to stay near the surface, making them accessible to snorkellers just as much as divers.
sentence_translations.translation: 觅食时，哈尼法鲁的蝠鲼往往靠近水面，这使得浮潜者和潜水者一样容易接近它们。

sentence_translations.sentence: They seem not to mind the human competition in this quite small space,and indeed they are often joined by other rays and even giant whale sharks, which feed on the same plankton.
sentence_translations.translation: 它们似乎不介意在这一狭小空间里与人类争抢，实际上它们还经常与其他鳐鱼甚至巨型鲸鲨一同出现，这些生物都以相同的浮游生物为食。

sentence_translations.sentence: Word among the diving community about the possibility of finding a mass of manta rays at Hanifaru has slowly been spreading over the past year.
sentence_translations.translation: 在过去一年里，关于在哈尼法鲁可能发现大量蝠鲼的消息在潜水界中慢慢传开。

sentence_translations.sentence: Outside the shallow lagoon I can see five large safari boats - live-aboard cruisers that take divers around the best underwater sites in the Maldives.
sentence_translations.translation: 在浅水泻湖外，我可以看到五艘大型观光船——这些是提供住宿的游船，能带领潜水者前往马尔代夫最佳的水下地点。

sentence_translations.sentence: It is something that Guy has been monitoring closely.
sentence_translations.translation: 盖伊一直在密切关注这一情况。

sentence_translations.sentence: "Word is out that Hanifaru is a top manta spot, ' he explains, 'and although the government has declared the bay a "protected area", we still don't have any regulations in force to limit the number of people in the water at any onetime.'
sentence_translations.translation: 他解释道：“消息传出，哈尼法鲁是一个顶级蝠鲼观赏点，尽管政府已宣布该海湾为‘保护区’，但我们仍没有有效的法规来限制任何时候在水中的游客数量。”

sentence_translations.sentence: Word among the diving community about the possibility of finding a mass of manta rays at Hanifaru has slowly been spreading over the past year.
sentence_translations.translation: 过去一年里，潜水圈中关于可能在哈尼法鲁发现大量蝠鲼的消息在慢慢传播开来。

sentence_translations.sentence: Outside the shallow lagoon I can see five large safari boats - live-aboard cruisers that take divers around the best underwater sites in the Maldives.
sentence_translations.translation: 在浅水泻湖外，我可以看到五艘大型观光船——这些船宿巡航艇带领潜水者前往马尔代夫最佳水下地点。

sentence_translations.sentence: It is something that Guy has been monitoring closely.
sentence_translations.translation: 这是盖伊一直在密切关注的事情。

sentence_translations.sentence: "Word is out that Hanifaru is a top manta spot, ' he explains, 'and although the government has declared the bay a "protected area", we still don't have any regulations in force to limit the number of people in the water at any onetime."
sentence_translations.translation: “消息传出，哈尼法鲁是一流的蝠鲼地点，”他解释道，“尽管政府已将该海湾宣布为‘保护区’，但我们仍然没有生效的规定来限制任何时候在水中的人数。”

sentence_translations.sentence: During my stay, the resort received a visit from the then-president of the Maldives, Mohamed Nasheed.
sentence_translations.translation: 在我停留期间，度假村接待了时任马尔代夫总统穆罕默德·纳希德的来访。

sentence_translations.sentence: Since coming to power in 2008, he had made his interest in the marine environment and concerns about climate change well known.
sentence_translations.translation: 自2008年执政以来，他明确表达了对海洋环境的兴趣以及对气候变化的担忧。

sentence_translations.sentence: In 2009 he held an underwater cabinet meeting, urging other world leaders to act decisively to combat climate change.
sentence_translations.translation: 2009年，他举行了一次水下内阁会议，敦促其他世界领导人果断采取行动应对气候变化。

sentence_translations.sentence: The protection of wildlife areas such as Hanifaru was clearly one of his objectives, and I asked him why he took such an interest.
sentence_translations.translation: 保护像哈尼法鲁这样的野生动物区域显然是他目标之一，我问他为何对此如此关注。

sentence_translations.sentence: ’Maldivians have lived with the reefs and their fish life since long before there were tourists,’ he said.
sentence_translations.translation: 他说：“早在游客出现之前，马尔代夫人就与珊瑚礁及其鱼类生活共存。”

sentence_translations.sentence: ’And while tourist dollars are good for our country, the sea and its produce are even more vital to my people.
sentence_translations.translation: “虽然旅游收入对我们国家有利，但海洋及其产物对我的人民更为重要。

sentence_translations.sentence: I have to balance what tourists want to see with preserving the marine environment - and in some cases, like Hanifaru, those objectives coincide.’
sentence_translations.translation: 我必须平衡游客想看的内容与保护海洋环境之间的关系——在某些情况下，比如哈尼法鲁，这些目标是一致的。”

sentence_translations.sentence: On several dives I am lucky enough to get close to the mantas, sometimes at underwater 'cleaning stations'.
sentence_translations.translation: 在几次潜水中，我有幸靠近蝠鲼，有时是在水下的“清洁站”。

sentence_translations.sentence: Here, the mantas come in small numbers, or individually, to pause above a coral outcrop and wait while small fish pick at their skin, removing parasites.
sentence_translations.translation: 在这里，蝠鲼三五成群或单独行动，停在珊瑚礁露头上方等待，让小鱼啄食它们的皮肤，清除寄生虫。

sentence_translations.sentence: Adapted for fast swimming with their flattened bodies, they can accelerate rapidly with a twitch of their wings.
sentence_translations.translation: 凭借扁平的身体适应快速游动，它们只需扇动一下翅膀就能迅速加速。

sentence_translations.sentence: They gaze at human swimmers with a kind of knowing calm, something people often remark on when they try to capture the emotion they experience after seeing them.
sentence_translations.translation: 它们以一种似有深意的平静凝视着人类游泳者，人们在试图描述见到它们后的感受时常常提及这一点。

sentence_translations.sentence: 'The manta rays have the biggest brain of any fish,' Guy explains, 'and some manta researchers are convinced that mantas can recognise individual people underwater.'
sentence_translations.translation: “蝠鲼拥有所有鱼类中最大的大脑，”盖伊解释道，“一些蝠鲼研究者确信，蝠鲼能在水下辨认出不同的人。”

sentence_translations.sentence: On several dives I am lucky enough to get close to the mantas,sometimes at underwater 'cleaning stations'.
sentence_translations.translation: 在几次潜水中，我有幸能接近这些蝠鲼，有时是在水下的“清洁站”。

sentence_translations.sentence: Here, the mantas come in small numbers, or individually, to pause above a coral outcrop and wait while small fish pick at their skin, removing parasites.
sentence_translations.translation: 在这里，蝠鲼少数或单独地前来，停留在珊瑚礁上方，等待小鱼啄食它们的皮肤，去除寄生虫。

sentence_translations.sentence: Adapted for fast swimming with their flattened bodies,they can accelerate rapidly with a twitch of their wings.
sentence_translations.translation: 凭借扁平的身体适应快速游泳，它们只需轻拍翅膀就能迅速加速。

sentence_translations.sentence: They gaze at human swimmers with a kind of knowing calm, something people often remark on when they try to capture the emotion they experience after seeing them.
sentence_translations.translation: 它们以一种似乎了然的平静凝视着人类游泳者，这是人们在试图描述看到它们后所感受到的情绪时常常提及的一点。

sentence_translations.sentence: 'The manta rays have the biggest brain of any fish,' Guy explains, 'and some manta researchers are convinced that mantas can recognise individual people underwater.'
sentence_translations.translation: “蝠鲼拥有所有鱼类中最大的大脑，”盖伊解释道，“一些蝠鲼研究者确信，蝠鲼能在水下识别不同的人。”

sentence_translations.sentence: I return to the lagoon over the course of several days and learn more from Guy about his hopes for the future.
sentence_translations.translation: 我连续几天返回泻湖，并从盖伊那里进一步了解了他对未来的期望。

sentence_translations.sentence: ‘People can visit this place, but I want to be sure that they don't harass the mantas by touching them or crowding them out while they're feeding.
sentence_translations.translation: “人们可以参观这个地方，但我希望确保他们不会在蝠鲼进食时通过触摸或拥挤它们来骚扰它们。

sentence_translations.sentence: We're working to get a full-time ranger station and some kind of permit system to limit the number of boats that can enter the lagoon each day.’
sentence_translations.translation: 我们正在努力设立一个全职巡逻站和某种许可制度，以限制每天能进入泻湖的船只数量。”

sentence_translations.sentence: I return to the lagoon over the course of several days and learn more from Guy about his hopes for the future.
sentence_translations.translation: 在接下来的几天里，我多次返回潟湖，并从盖伊那里进一步了解到他对未来的期望。

sentence_translations.sentence: ‘People can visit this place, but I want to be sure that they don't harass the mantas by touching them or crowding them out while they're feeding.
sentence_translations.translation: “人们可以参观这个地方，但我要确保他们不会在蝠鲼进食时通过触摸或挤占它们而进行骚扰。

sentence_translations.sentence: We're working to get a full-time ranger station and some kind of permit system to limit the number of boats that can enter the lagoon each day.’
sentence_translations.translation: 我们正在努力争取建立一个全职护林站和某种许可证制度，以限制每天可以进入潟湖的船只数量。”
